Hyatt Sea Turtle Conservation — Boardwalk
🗺️ Add Map Link

Walk 20 min north along the boardwalk to the Hyatt's beach turtle programme. View rescued and hatching sea turtles in care. June is nesting season — very active

Sanur Beachfront Boardwalk
🗺️ Add Map Link

5 km paved path lined with colourful jukung boats — Bali's most photogenic fishing boats. Walk north toward Sunrise Beach area.📸 Photo: boats against Agung volcano backdrop

Sanur Sunrise Beach Viewpoint
🗺️ Add Map Link

Despite the name, beautiful at any time. Clear views of Nusa Penida and Mt. Agung. Perfect golden hour shot.

Sindhu Beach Market
🗺️ Add Map Link

A small afternoon market near Jl. Danau Tamblingan selling local snacks, fresh coconut, batik wraps. Great intro to local life.

Bali's most photographed temple gate with Mt. Agung framed perfectly between split gates. Entry ~IDR 100k. The "floating" reflection is done with a mirror/water held under the gate by attendants.

Tirta Gangga Water Palace
🗺️ Add Map Link

Former royal water palace with elegant stepped pools, giant koi fish, stone stepping paths, and lush gardens against a highland backdrop. Entry IDR 90k. You can swim in the bathing pools.

transport.t_0: Transport Airport → Sanur: Pre-book a private cab or use Bluebird taxi (metered, most reliable). ~30–40 min, ~IDR 150–200k. Avoid touts inside arrivals. All Sanur activities are walkable along the 5 km beach boardwalk. Rent bicycles (IDR 50k/day) from your hotel for easy exploration.
transport.t_2: Hired Private Car & Driver (full day) Hire from hotel or Klook/GetYourGuide. Full day east Bali circuit: IDR 600–800k. Route: Sanur → Lempuyang (2.5 hrs) → Tirta Gangga (20 min from Lempuyang) → Besakih (1 hr from Tirta Gangga) → optional Sidemen Valley → back to Sanur. ~200 km round trip. Driver handles parking; you focus on photography.

tipbox.tip_0: 📍 Arrival Note Check in, freshen up. Sanur is the perfect relaxed entry into Bali — calm beach, no surf crowds, great food. The famous 5 km beachfront boardwalk links everything.
